_readme: EXAMPLE: Dragino LDS02 door switch. Not read by the service; copy from here.
1. Copy the block under "devices" into the "devices" object of server/python/devices.json.
2. Replace the devEUI key (lowercase, 16 hex chars) with your sensor's, and change name and ntfy_topic.
3. "family" must be the ChirpStack device-profile name: Dragino Switch LDS02.
4. Secrets stay as ${ENV_VAR} placeholders; export LORALARM_PUSHOVER_USER / LORALARM_PUSHOVER_TOKEN.
5. Save devices.json: it is hot-reloaded, no restart. Open and close the door to test.
Everything except name and family is optional; the type's defaults fill the gaps.
No threshold/frequency/duration here: this device has no downlink settings.
watchdog_hours: the LDS02 only reports on change plus a heartbeat, so keep it long (12 h).
batt_*: 2 x AAA, an assumption (3.0 / 2.5 / 2.2 V); tune against a real discharge.
notify_fire / notify_clear are keyed by alarm kind; {name} {detail} {label} are available.
TWO DEVICES: settings shared by every LDS02 live once under "families"; Door1 is the minimal case,
Door2 overrides two values (watchdog_hours 2, and an alarm_window so it only alarms at night).
Precedence, later wins: the type's built-in defaults, "defaults", "families", the device entry.
ALARM WINDOW: "alarm_window": "21:00-09:00" on Door2 = door alarms (open and closed) are only sent between
21:00 and 09:00 local time ("timezone" in defaults, default Europe/Stockholm). Outside it nothing is sent,
the event is still logged. A low battery or a silent sensor is still reported at any time. Door1 has no
window, so it alarms day and night. Leave alarm_window out (or "") for 'always'.
